watch.summary: A streamer laughs hysterically while watching footage of a robot goalkeeper stand completely frozen after getting scored on.

beats.what: Streamer watches footage of a robot soccer match.
A robot takes a kick at the goal.
The ball sails into the net while the robot goalkeeper stands completely still without moving.
Streamer bursts into wild laughter at the keeper robot's zero reaction.
Streamer imitates the frozen stance of the goalkeeper robot.
Streamer rewatches the clip and points out the 3-second delay in reaction time.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: The dude did not react for like three seconds.
watch.why: The visual slapstick of a robot goalkeeper standing completely motionless after getting scored on is universally funny. The streamer's infectious wheezing laugh and animated breakdown highlight the absurd delay perfectly.
